sections.content: How many people stayed in Burley in Wharfedale after gaining qualifications?

Burley in Wharfedale is a small town in Yorkshire and The Humber. Burley in Wharfedale does not have its own university.

Burley in Wharfedale has lower levels of deprivation.

Overall, Burley in Wharfedale ended up with:

  • fewer graduates than it produced
Note: all towns and cities in this analysis are defined based on population size only. This means that some cities are classed as towns because of their population.

Let's explore this further

There were 270 state-school pupils from Burley in Wharfedale who sat their GCSEs between the 2007 to 2008 and the 2010 to 2011 school years.

Of these, 150 (56%) went on to gain degree-level qualifications (level 6+ as defined by The Office of Qualifications and Examinations Regulation, or Ofqual ). We will call these people graduates.

Another 75 (28%) went on to gain other advanced post-16 qualifications, such as A-Levels, a foundation degree or higher apprenticeship (levels 3-5 as defined by Ofqual). In this tool, we will refer to these non-graduates with advanced qualifications as “qualified non-graduates", for brevity.

The charts below compare Burley in Wharfedale to other English towns and cities using three measures:

  • what proportion of Burley in Wharfedale's pupils became graduates or qualified non-graduates by the 2017 to 2018 academic year
  • of those graduates and qualified non-graduates, the percentages that lived in Burley in Wharfedale in the 2018 to 2019 academic year
  • how many graduates and qualified non-graduates from elsewhere came to live there by 2018 to 2019, relative to the number who sat their GCSEs there

In some towns, some of this information may not be available because of small sample sizes.
The size and deprivation level of a town, as well as the qualification levels of older residents, were all related to students' educational attainment. Read our previous analysis.

Of those in Burley in Wharfedale's GCSE cohort:

  • 30 graduates left Yorkshire and The Humber

In 2018 to 2019, 22% of graduates living in Burley in Wharfedale had moved there from elsewhere

In the 2018 to 2019 academic year, there were 115 graduates from our cohort living in Burley in Wharfedale, compared with the 150 graduates who had lived there when they sat their GCSEs.

In the 2018 to 2019 academic year, 74% of graduates had sat their GCSEs in Burley in Wharfedale, while 22% had moved there from elsewhere.
